entries.46062bd7087f442b: 'EBISUMART' is characterized by being a cloud-based service that can nevertheless be customized to customer requirements. It combines the advantage of ASP services, that 'the system does not become outdated', with the advantage of packaged software, that it can be customized for linkage with other systems, and by adding functions and updating every week, customers can always use the latest service. In contract system development, it adopts a project management system, with the same members in charge from requirements definition through design, development, testing and delivery, aiming to strengthen quality and respond quickly when failures occur. It also publishes APIs and, through the partner program 'EBISUMART ecosystem', has put in place an environment in which partner companies can develop EC support service applications that run on 'EBISUMART'.
